waiver.text: duel-board.tsx pushes a distinct dv-cut class the instant a built junction goes dark while staying built, so the permanence of built ground is shown as its own visual state on every render, not stated in words.
waiver.expiresIf: duel-board.tsx stops pushing dv-cut for a built, unlit junction, or dv-cut is rendered the same as an unbuilt cell so the distinction stops being visible.

label.why: MECHANIC_INVENTORY has no row for builtVsPower at all (the silent-gap class), so the waiver above has nothing to attach to until this row exists. This label adds the row with the waiver text carried inline, since apply_patch's add_waiver helper can only attach a waiver to a row that already exists, never create one. Chained after 06-oneUndo.json's insertion so both land without colliding.

claims.resolves: DuelCell.built is a permanent flag, set once a node is ever lit; a later cut removes power but never clears built, which is what dv-cut renders as its own state.
